transcript.text: bosch 24 not draining, water sitting in bottom. help
I can help. “24” may be part of a model/series rather than an error code, and the checks differ by appliance. Is it a Bosch dishwasher, washing machine or washer-dryer?
dishwasher. display shows E:24. model SMS24AW01G

E:24 on this Bosch dishwasher means it has not been able to drain. The usual cause is a blocked filter/sump or something caught at the drain pump; next are a kinked drain hose or blocked sink-waste connection. A failed pump is less common until those are ruled out. 1. Switch it off and unplug it. Remove the lower rack, twist out the filter and rinse it thoroughly. Clear food, grease and any glass from the sump below it. This is the most common fix. 2. Bail out the standing water with a cup and sponge. With gloves on, lift the small pump cover in the sump if accessible, then use a torch to check for glass, labels, bones or other debris. Gently feel whether the small impeller turns; remove any obstruction. Do not force it. 3. Check the drain hose behind the dishwasher and under the sink for a squash or kink. Then run the kitchen tap: if the sink waste drains slowly or backs up, clear that plumbing connection first. 4. Refit the filter securely, restore power and run Cancel/Drain or a rinse programme for a couple of minutes. A hum/buzz with no draining usually means a remaining blockage or jam; no pump sound after the path is clear makes the drain pump or its supply more likely. If the filter, sump, hose and sink waste are all clear but it still will not drain, it is time for an engineer to diagnose the drain pump and wiring rather than replacing parts blindly.
filter was clogged with food and a bit of broken glass. cleaned it, now drains normally and E:24 is gone. no kinks in hose, pump cover fine, impeller turns, sink waste clear.

That has fixed it: the blocked filter was preventing the dishwasher from draining and caused the E:24 message. No part or engineer is needed. For prevention, rinse the filter regularly and take extra care after any broken glass—small fragments can work through to the pump area. If E:24 returns despite a clean filter, then investigate the hose, waste connection and drain pump, but there is no sign of that at present.
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
